company.name: Theta Labs
company.shortDescription: Theta Labs is a software development company that provides decentralized cloud and blockchain infrastructure for AI, video, and rendering.
company.description: Theta Labs pioneered Theta Network, the leading media, entertainment & video blockchain company. Theta has a proprietary Layer-1 proof-of-stake blockchain that enables existing video platforms to drive incremental revenues and reduce content delivery CDN costs while end-users are rewarded for sharing their bandwidth to relay video on a peer-to-peer basis on any PC, mobile, Smart TV or IoT device. Strategic corporate investors include Samsung NEXT, Sony Innovation Fund, media investors BDMI Bertelsmann Digital Media Investments, CAA Creative Artists Agency, and traditional Silicon Valley VCs including DCM and Sierra Ventures.

aiResearchSummary.text: Theta Labs is researching a Hybrid Cloud-Edge Computing Architecture for Decentralized Computing Platform that uses decentralized networks to perform resource intensive machine learning and video processing. Through Edge Computing Nodes Supported by Smart Contract Enabled Blockchain Network, they coordinate computation tasks on chain. With a Decentralized edge storage network with flexible file sharding, they distribute file storage across peer nodes. Together these efforts target decentralized compute, blockchain coordination, and edge storage.
